question: What was one of the primary arguments used by Raja Rammohun Roy against the practice of sati?
answer: He tried to show through his writings that widow burning had no sanction in ancient texts.
options: He argued that British officials strongly demanded its immediate ban.
He tried to show through his writings that widow burning had no sanction in ancient texts.
He claimed that it caused severe economic loss to the family.
He stated that neighboring countries had already banned the practice.
explanation: Rammohun Roy used his knowledge of ancient texts to prove that sati had no religious or scriptural backing in ancient traditions, thereby undermining the custom.
question_hi: सती प्रथा के विरुद्ध राजा राममोहन राय द्वारा इस्तेमाल किए गए मुख्य तर्कों में से एक क्या था?
options_hi: उन्होंने तर्क दिया कि ब्रिटिश अधिकारियों ने इस पर तुरंत प्रतिबंध लगाने की पुरजोर मांग की थी।
उन्होंने अपने लेखन के माध्यम से यह दिखाने का प्रयास किया कि प्राचीन ग्रंथों में विधवा दहन का कोई समर्थन नहीं था।
उन्होंने दावा किया कि इससे परिवार को भारी आर्थिक नुकसान होता है।

explanation_hi: राममोहन राय ने प्राचीन ग्रंथों के अपने ज्ञान का उपयोग यह साबित करने के लिए किया कि सती प्रथा का प्राचीन परंपराओं में कोई धार्मिक आधार नहीं था।

question: What did Raja Rammohun Roy write about regarding the condition of women in his time?
answer: Women were forced to bear the burden of domestic work and were not allowed to become educated.
options: Women were given excessive freedom in household decision-making.
Women were encouraged to travel abroad for higher education.
Women were forced to bear the burden of domestic work and were not allowed to become educated.
Women held prominent administrative positions in the government.
explanation: The text notes that Rammohun Roy wrote about how women were forced to bear the burden of domestic work, confined to the home and kitchen, and denied education.

explanation_hi: पाठ में उल्लेख है कि राममोहन राय ने लिखा था कि कैसे महिलाओं को घरेलू काम का बोझ उठाने के लिए मजबूर किया जाता था, घर और रसोई तक सीमित रखा जाता था और शिक्षा से वंचित रखा जाता था।
